facts.statement: At the 2026-01-15 signing date, the only published on-network Canton Coin price was a fee-denomination reference of USD 0.0005 per CC, used to convert the USD fee schedule into coin for paying network (gas) fees.

anchors.quote: Canton Coin (CC) fee-reference price: USD 0.0005 per CC

facts.statement: The published 0.0005 USD/CC figure is an administratively/protocol-set fee-conversion parameter, not an exchange quotation or arm's-length transaction price; there is no order book, bid/ask, or settled market trade behind it.

facts.statement: At the signing date Canton Coin was not listed or traded on any public exchange; no active market existed for the coin.

anchors.quote: At the signing date Canton Coin was not listed or traded on any public

facts.statement: Informal OTC channels show asks, bids, and self-reported settled trades for Canton Coin in the range of approximately 0.0030 to 0.0038 USD per CC in the two weeks around signing, with two self-reported settled trades at 0.0032 and 0.0033 USD per CC.
